# is about

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:isAbout`](gmeow-isAbout.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/isAbout>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/tags`](../../slices/tags.md)

Aboutness — a resource is about another resource. Distinct from typing ([rdf:type](http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type)) and from tagging ([`gmeow:hasTag`](gmeow-hasTag.md)): aboutness is a semantic subject-matter relation, tagging is a user-applied label, and typing is an ontological classification. Non-functional.
